_meta.character_voice: Dirk: najbardziej wspolczesny/luzny jezykowo bohater gry (potwierdzone w devTexts Art Gallery, patrz GLOSSARY) - duzo wtracen 'you know'/'I mean'/'like', mlodziezowy/aktorski luz. Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds0.en:
Heyyy, what's up?
How's it going?
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds0.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds10.en: Uh, yeah, we're here to investigate the - [i]murder[/i] - of Magnus Mortuga.
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds10.pl: Yy, tak, jesteśmy tu, żeby zbadać - [i]morderstwo[/i] - Magnusa Mortugi.
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds10.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds11.en: [h]Oh,[/h] yeah - major bummer, honestly - he was a pretty standup guy.
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds11.pl: [h]Oo,[/h] tak - naprawdę wielki dołek, szczerze - był całkiem spoko gościem.
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds11.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds12.en: Dirk - you didn't tell us your surname.
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds12.pl: Dirk - nie powiedziałeś nam swojego nazwiska.
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds12.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds21.en: I mean, you know, sure - kind of an oddball, but like, in a good way? You know, I mean, he-
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds21.pl: No wiesz, no jasne - trochę dziwak, ale tak w dobrym sensie? No wiesz, no bo on-
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds21.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds22.en: So - yeah anyway... um, hi! And, uh - what can I do for you folks?
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds22.pl: Więc - tak w sumie... yy, hej! I, yy - co mogę dla was zrobić?
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds22.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds23.en:
He's adorable.
Can we keep him?
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds23.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds24.en:
No.
You'd forget to feed him.
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds24.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds6.en: Uh... it's going good. I think.
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds6.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds7.en: Awesome, yeah - um, I'm Dirk by the way. Who are you guys?
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds7.pl: Super, tak - yy, jestem Dirk, swoją drogą. A wy kim jesteście?
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds7.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds8.en: I'm... Grimoire, and this is Sally-
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds8.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds9.en: Ohh cool, cool - so - you're the detectives?
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds9.pl: Ooo super, super - czyli - jesteście detektywami?
Conversation/Dirk 01 INTRO/Section ds9.speaker: Dirk
